firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Section 6 (External Data and Tools) says External Data must be "publicly available and equally accessible to use by all Participants of the Competition for purposes of the competition."

  Suppose a team writes its own code to procedurally generate synthetic ARC-AGI-3-style games (not derived from any hidden evaluation data) and uses them to develop, test, or train parts of its solution.

  1. Is that self-generated data "External Data" under Section 6, or is it simply part of the team's own solution, like its code?

  2. If it counts as External Data, must it (or the generator) be published before the competition ends, and before a submission that uses it? Or is releasing it with the winner's open-source obligations (CC-BY 4.0, reproducible methodology) enough?

  3. Does the answer change if a model trained on that data is included in the submission?

  A host confirmation would help many teams. Thanks!
